title: BJP and Mahayuti allies hold Lokshahi Bachao padyatra in Mumbai
seoTitle: Mumbai BJP holds Lokshahi Bachao march

tea.why: The BJP and Mahayuti alliance held the march to oppose Congress narratives regarding constitutional institutions and the electoral process.
tea.want: To counter opposition claims and support the current government's governance and constitutional adherence.
tea.changed: Nov 1: The march concluded in Mumbai with leaders criticising the opposition's stance on the judiciary and Parliament.

summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its Mahayuti allies conducted a 'Lokshahi Bachao, Anarajakta Hatao' (Save Democracy, Remove Anarchy) foot march in Mumbai on November 1, 2026. BJP Maharashtra President Ravindra Chavan stated the event was organised to address what he described as the opposition's false narratives regarding constitutional institutions, including the judiciary and Parliament. Shiv Sena MP Naresh Mhaske also participated, criticising Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and his associates for activities he alleged were against the Constitution. The march is part of a broader national campaign by the BJP to communicate its position on the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and to counter opposition allegations. No official response from the opposition was reported in the provided sources.
demands: Counter opposition narratives on electoral rolls
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The BJP and Mahayuti allies held a padyatra in Mumbai to protest against opposition narratives.
